name: AutoPlaylist
description: AutoPlaylist turns your Jellyfin music library into a growing set of thematic, hand-curated playlists. A local LLM served by Ollama looks at what your library actually holds, chooses an angle, then picks every track by musical judgment — no genre-filter automation. Playlists it owns are marked with a tag, so your own playlists are never touched. Runs nightly as a scheduled task.
overview: LLM-curated music playlists, built from your own library

versions.changelog: Keep the recency playlist's description static
